name: USS Farragut
shortDescription: Hard-hitting tier IV gunboat with fast, high-DPM guns and short-legged torpedoes.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 40s cooldown, unlimited charges. Standard USN destroyer cycle, back up before a second fire usually catches you.

consumables.name: Smoke Generator
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, 25s to lay, roughly 115s of screen, 240s cooldown. 'Extended Smoke' is a named ship trait, but you only get two chances to use it.

consumables.name: Engine Boost
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, +8% speed for 120s, 180s cooldown. Enough uptime to plan a push around, not just bail out of one fight.

torpedoMounts.note: Both mounts sit on the centerline and can traverse to either broadside.

strengths: Fast-reloading 127mm battery gives some of the best gun DPM at tier IV
Above-average fire chance keeps HE spam dangerous
High top speed with a quick rudder shift, easy to reposition
weaknesses: Less hull HP than tier IV rival Nicholas
Floaty shell arcs make long-range hits inconsistent
Short torpedo range keeps the fish a close-range tool only
Bad concealment gets you spotted first in most fights
No repair party, so damage taken is permanent
tips: Lead with your guns against other destroyers. The DPM usually wins a straight fight at this tier.
Close the distance before opening up, those arcing shells miss more at range.
Cap early and hold your position, but keep an escape route in mind before you commit.
Save torpedoes for a ship that's already pushed in close. The range is too short to chip-damage from afar.

threats.reason: They strip away your smoke's usefulness and can punish you at range.
They dictate the terms of the fight if they see you first.

summary: A gunboat destroyer built around a fast, hard-hitting 127mm battery, not a knife fighter.
Gun DPM and fire chance lead the way, torpedoes are a short-ranged backup.
Fast and nimble, but thin-skinned and easy to spot for the tier.
playstyle.detail: Farragut plays more like a small cruiser than a knife in the dark. She can trade shells with almost any destroyer her tier and usually come out ahead on damage per minute, so she doesn't need to hide the way some others do. Contest caps, spot when it's safe, and treat the torpedoes as a finishing move rather than the whole plan. Just don't forget there's no repair party behind that hull, and no armor to speak of either.

goalTags.note: Fast-reloading 127mm guns with above-average fire chance make her one of the better HE spam boats at tier IV.
